short_horizon_definition.interpretation: Diagnostic flag for likely repost or lightly reformulated same-event observations; not a general duplicate-removal rule.

boundary_selection_note: Candidate boundaries were calendar-based diagnostic cutoffs only and were not selected using model performance.
findings: No exact normalized-text duplicates were found in the dense candidate benchmark.
A small number of high-similarity observations exist, primarily consistent with rapid reposting or lightly reformulated financial news.
High textual similarity alone is not treated as duplication because templated macroeconomic headlines can remain highly similar across different release dates.
No suspicious short-horizon near-duplicate pair crossed any of the five tested calendar-based candidate boundaries.
recommended_future_guard: After the final chronological cutoff is selected, repeat the short-horizon near-duplicate check at that exact boundary before model training.
